parameters.note: McCleod Lake (spelled 'McLeod Lake' in the regulations, GNIS, and OpenStreetMap) is listed in CCR §7.50(b)(92) as a special-regulation water: open all year, artificial lures with barbless hooks only, zero-trout bag limit.

candidates.summary: Open all year, catch-and-release only (artificial lures with barbless hooks; zero-trout bag limit)

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists McCleod Lake (Region 6, Mono Co.) for fingerling-size Lahontan Cutthroat Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of August-September. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
